astrologer.avoid: Keep the sundial and moth plain and handmade, with no zodiac-wizard trappings, glowing runes or ornate brass instruments that recall a famous magic-school or fantasy franchise's props.

madeleine-lengle.avoid: Keep the mug a plain, unbranded mug (no café logo, mascot face or famous coffee-chain shape), and keep the galaxy a small swirl of our own rather than any recognisable cover art from A Wrinkle in Time or its film adaptations.
